messages:
anya: Quick post-all-hands thread. We're prepping a small internal canary for kernel-v2. Two asks: 1) concrete tuning knobs for sub-120ms p50 on short chat bursts, 2) what's the simplest rollback trigger you'd want ops to use?

samir: Short answers: knobs -> small batches and tight microbatch windows; rollback -> explicit SLO excursions + OOM threshold. We'll share the exact gate script tonight.

leo: Concrete knobs we've validated: microbatch_window_ms=3-5, max_batch_size=4-7, enable prefix cache for repeated prompts. If memory allows, kv_prewarm=true reduces tail latency.

anya: Can you give a one-line justification for kv_prewarm memory use? Ops will need wording for the runbook.

leo: One-liner: kv_prewarm trades ~+6-10% resident memory for significantly higher KV hit rate, cutting per-token latency on warm prefixes by up to ~30%.

zhen: Ops rollback suggestion: automated rollback if any of these hold for >3 minutes: p50 > 150ms OR p95 > 450ms OR OOMs > 0 in canary pool. Also flag KV hit ratio drop >25% vs baseline.

diana: Telemetry note: tag traces with canary=kernel-v2 and include batch_config in span attributes. Please set trace_sample_rate=100% for canary traffic. We'll need microbatch_delay histogram too.

anya: Got it. Any easy script to paste into the canary job for batching config?

leo: Minimal YAML to paste:
```
runtime:
  kernel: v2
  pool: canary-small
batching:
  enabled: true
  microbatch_window_ms: 4
  max_batch_size: 6
cache:
  kv_prewarm: true
  kv_adaptive: false
monitoring:
  trace_tags: ["canary:kernel-v2","batch_profile"]
  trace_sample_rate: 100%
```

zhen: Ops note: pin canary to identical GPU nodes, disable autoscale, and enable continuous trace export. If rollback triggers twice in 24h, escalate to kernel leads.

ops-bot: deploy queued -> job #7210 (kernel-v2) -> canary-small. Estimated start 06:10 UTC.

anya: Thanks all — compiling checklist now. Please drop any short simulators or perf scripts if you have them.
